jobs.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Make a single vertical 4:5 candid smartphone photo for a fictional Korean parenting feed, converting the FIRST supplied Blender render into a real photographic scene. Image 1 is the mandatory spatial composition and product geometry reference. Image 2 is ONLY the fictional preschool boy's identity, black hair, sage sweatshirt and cream trousers; never import its old toys or camera view. Image 3 is the actual tablet screen texture containing the existing TangoBook Korean phonics unit kr-h1-u02 furniture image; preserve that exact chair-and-drawer felt illustration on the tablet, and the large Korean word '가구'. Preserve the camera position, crop, table/chair positions, window and storage cabinet positions and proportions of image 1. The board is the NEW compact square 14-by-14 stud recognition board, about 226 mm square, white, with small rounded studs, attached tall rounded white tablet cradle. NEVER use the old 500-mm rectangular board, old open-letter-shaped pieces, generic alphabet cubes, or a different tablet. Blocks are thin rounded YELLOW plastic bodies, 2x2 square consonant pieces and 1x2 narrow vowel pieces, with WHITE flat paper stickers and BLACK Korean letters. Keep the exact count, size, positions, orientation and readable lettering from image 1. In the second syllable the same ㅏ sticker block is physically rotated clockwise to form ㅜ. Keep the orange camera mirror attachment on the tablet upper edge. Photo style: a mom casually took a real photo in daylight; true wood pores, subtle painted wall texture, natural fabric knit and wrinkles, real child hair and skin. Convert the stylized 3D child into the same real-looking fictional 4-year-old boy, with anatomically connected arms, small natural hands and five fingers, naturally reaching toward the board. Preserve actual furniture occlusion; do not invent feet in a crop that hides them. No added text outside the tablet or stickers, no watermark, no glossy CGI surfaces, no cartoon body or plastic hair. The room stays the same size and layout, including existing wall art and books. Camera: preserve the behind-the-child viewpoint of image 1 exactly. The back of his head and sweatshirt occupy the same portion of the frame. Tablet screen and square board remain beyond his hands.
